Panels & cards

Purpose: group related content. Panel = flat bordered surface for

Purpose: group related content. Panel = flat bordered surface for sections and forms. Card = elevated + shadowed for peer-level items (listings, stats, previews). Same geometry, different altitude.

Usage

<section class="sq-panel" aria-labelledby="billing-title">
  <div class="sq-panel__header">
    <h2 class="sq-heading--3" id="billing-title">Billing</h2>
    <p class="sq-text sq-muted">
      Invoices land here on the first of the month.
    </p>
  </div>
  <div class="sq-panel__body">
    <div class="sq-panel">
      <p class="sq-text">Nested content carves inward automatically.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="sq-panel__footer">
    <button class="sq-button sq-button--primary" type="button">Save</button>
    <button class="sq-button sq-button--tertiary" type="button">Cancel</button>
  </div>
</section>

<article class="sq-card">
  <h3 class="sq-heading--4">Turnaround 6.2h</h3>
  <p class="sq-text sq-muted">Fleet average, trailing 7 days.</p>
</article>

Variants

ClassUse
sq-panelDefault flat surface.
sq-panel--sunkenInset regions (code wells, read-only previews).
sq-panel--elevatedPanel that must float without becoming a card.
sq-panel--largeRoomier padding for major sections.
sq-cardElevated peer item.
sq-card--interactiveClickable card (see stretched link below).

Header/body/footer sections are optional and composable — use any subset. The header carries a divider; the footer wraps actions with real gaps.

Nesting

.sq-panel .sq-panel steps down one radius grade and one elevation automatically. Never hand-tune nested radii; never stack more than two deep (restructure instead — depth is a smell).

Interactive cards

One link per card, stretched over the surface, one tab stop:

<article class="sq-card sq-card--interactive">
  <h3 class="sq-heading--4">The 64-pixel rule</h3>
  <p class="sq-text sq-muted">Section rhythm should be a token.</p>
  <a class="sq-stretched-link" href="/essays/64px">Read the essay</a>
</article>

The card lifts on hover (settles under reduced motion) and rings on focus-within via the global focus rule. Never nest interactive controls inside a stretched-link card — one action per surface.

Disclosure (collapsible surfaces)

Native <details>/<summary> — no JavaScript, platform keyboard support, state in the open attribute:

<details class="sq-disclosure" open>
  <summary>When do exports run?</summary>
  <div class="sq-disclosure__content">
    <p class="sq-text">Nightly at 02:00 UTC, plus on demand.</p>
  </div>
</details>

Summary text names the section (always visible, always a complete label); content grids with room. The accent chevron rotates on open (static under reduced motion). This resolves the Stage 3 "no collapsible surfaces" limitation: single-open accordion groups remain out of scope (use separate disclosures — forcing exclusivity needs a custom system native HTML deliberately avoids).

Surface hierarchy

Page (deepest) → panel → nested panel / card → overlay (dialogs, Stage 4). If everything is elevated, nothing is: default to flat panels, promote to cards only for peer groups that must separate from the page. Bright accents never fill large surfaces.

Accessibility

  • Panels grouping a topic get a heading (aria-labelledby where the

heading is the label). Decorative wrappers stay dumb <div>s.

  • Interactive cards keep exactly one link; the visible link text is the

accessible name — no aria-label needed, none wanted.

  • Dividers (<hr class="sq-divider">) are native separators; vertical

dividers are aria-hidden presentation.

Theme behavior

Surfaces, borders, dividers, and shadows are tokens; the navy ramp re-maps under Ocean without markup changes. Elevation must remain visible in every theme (shadow + border both shift, never just one).

Common mistakes

  • Card for a whole page section — use a panel; cards are peers.
  • Three levels of nesting — restructure.
  • Buttons inside stretched-link cards — nested interactives break

keyboard and screen-reader users alike.

Tested limitations

  • Single-open accordion groups (use separate disclosures instead).
  • sq-card--interactive lift is hover/keyboard-focus driven; touch

users get the link with no lift, which is correct.
